title: Workspace includes a module from outside the repository
description: go.work declares a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root. A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root.
remediation: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root.
limitation: It matches a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root in the parsed go.work; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
